title: Playing Dumaine's numbers versus stock arrangements at clubs
summary: Asked whether the Dumaine tunes were played in dance work, he says the big clubs wanted stock arrangements; the rest is garbled ASR.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about some of the pieces that you played with Louis Demain. Did he write many numbers? I know when he made the records he had the number he called Franklin Street Blues and Red Onion Drag. I wonder, did you ever play those in the dance band that you worked with him?

Well, after we started playing, see like all these big clubs, the Sun Yacht Club, and all this country. They started playing nothing with stock. They wouldn't play them. They would normally like the rice. They played mostly stock. They had to build their dear
